howto: Pick a crop, then tap an empty plot to plant it.
Tap a growing plot to water it (twice as fast), and tap it again when it glows to harvest and sell it.
Spend coins in the shop on plots, a sprinkler, a harvester and chickens, and chase the goal at the top.
tips: Each harvest of a crop raises its price by 6% for good.
Harvests sometimes drop a seed. Saved seeds are planted first, for free.
Three harvests within two seconds of each other make a combo.
The Sprinkler waters everything and the Harvester replants for you.
Crops and chickens keep working while you are away, for up to two hours.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a plot or button and press Enter or Space. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap crops, plots and shop buttons

difficulty: Self-paced: dearer crops take longer but pay more, plot unlocks double in price, and each goal is a bigger coin total.

cheats.effect: Coin shower: a big pile of coins
Quick grow: every planted crop is ready now
Magic beans: 10 free seeds of every crop

features.autosave: The farm saves on this device every 5 seconds and when you leave (not while codes are on)
features.goals-or-quests: Goal bar under the top bar: the next coin total to earn, with a coin reward when you reach it
features.day-time-ui: Day number and clock in the top bar (6:00 to 22:00, dusk dims the farm) and a Day summary card at the end of each day
features.inventory: The 🎒 Barn: saved seeds for every crop, harvest counts and mastery prices, plots and helpers
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first visit: pick, plant, water, harvest and the shop; replay with Learn to play
features.results: Day summary card with crops harvested and coins earned that day
